_comment: The Part 1 seed set. `text` is the ONLY field sent to the model — style/bucket/discriminator are our labels and must never enter a prompt.

seeds.discriminator: Staggered adoption + selection into treatment; deposits are not revenue
seeds.text: Do customers who start trading on Kalshi subsequently reduce their spend and activity on DraftKings? We have a credit-card and bank-deposit transaction panel covering both.

seeds.discriminator: Seats contracted != seats used; ARR is seats x price and MAU is blind to price/mix
seeds.text: Do monthly active users on a company's client-facing portal predict ARR for SaaS companies on seat-based pricing?

seeds.discriminator: Leaky validation; needs external ground truth and an abstain class
seeds.text: Can we reliably identify European financial institutions from transaction data, using only anonymized institution IDs plus the demographics and spend behavior of a panel of customers?

seeds.discriminator: SPV guarantee removal is a VIE consolidation fact before it is a strategy signal
seeds.text: A hyperscaler was removed as a guarantor on a new SPV with its longstanding chip manufacturer. Is this a sign they are qualifying a second source and pushing risk back onto their primary provider?

seeds.discriminator: Crowded and mined; sentiment is collinear with the earnings surprise
seeds.text: Does sentiment expressed on earnings calls predict a company's outperformance versus its peers?

seeds.discriminator: Near-tautological; simultaneity and definitional circularity in the forward multiple
seeds.text: Do changes in next-two-year revenue and EBITDA CAGR drive earnings-multiple re-ratings among peers within an industry?

seeds.discriminator: Published sell-side work is consensus by construction; guidance is a policy choice
seeds.text: Sell-side channel checks are incrementally positive on new logo wins. Should we expect a meaningful boost to full-year guidance at the upcoming print, and is this a long?

seeds.discriminator: Proxy polarity is backwards; retail is identified off sub-penny off-exchange prints, not lot size
seeds.text: Do round-lot orders identify retail flow that is profitable to trade against?

seeds.discriminator: Narrative anchoring; shortages are a cycle-peak tell and backlog is inflated by double-ordering
seeds.text: A company just guided to product shortages lasting through next year. Does that portend more customer long-term agreements and more durable revenue?

seeds.discriminator: Signal confounded at source: guardedness is the baseline during any live negotiation
seeds.text: A company went notably defensive around its annual vendor licence renegotiation. Is this a stronger near-term risk to margins than management has communicated, or is it not a sign of weakening fundamentals?
